retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Retest generally allowed the next day; office and online-vendor policy varies
retake.retakeFee: Additional testing fee may apply through third-party vendors

gdl.permitMinAge: 15 (with driver education); 15 yrs 6 mo with driver awareness course
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night) with a supervising driver age 21+
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-5 a.m. for the first 12 months of licensing (exceptions for work, school, medical, or emergencies)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: no passengers under 21. Second 6 months: no more than 1 passenger under 21 (family exceptions apply)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. birth certificate or U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: Colorado driver licenses and IDs are REAL ID compliant by default (a black star). Applicants provide proof of identity, Social Security number, and Colorado residency; a non-REAL-ID option is available on request.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Adults 21+: 12 points in 12 months or 18 in 24 months. Under 18: 6 points in 12 months or 7 before age 18
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, when safe, move over one lane for stopped emergency, maintenance, tow, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph or as posted, with doubled fines
